title: 第一章 坑爹的体位第二章 送葬赞歌
slug: 盗三界第五百六十章黑影
lines: 明月高悬星海，天地江河皆白。
万物竞生机。
许源睁眼之际，便看到如此良辰美景。
“好景！正合我心意！”
他赞了一声，心中升起雀跃与憧憬。
几个小时前——
他刚登上全球电子竞技联赛之顶，成为多项电竞游戏的年度冠军和最有价值选手。
原本正要跟朋友庆祝一番。
谁知飞机坠海失事了。
他没能幸存，但却在另一个世界活了过来。
——眼下这具身体的主人也叫许源，是一名普通高三学生。
自己穿越到这个世界，在这个学生身上，替代了对方。
既来之，则安之。
在这美丽的夜色下——
许源发誓要好好生活，尽情感受青春的鲜活与美好。
那么。
第一步。
自拍发圈啊！
许源摸出手机，调整角度，“咔嚓”了一张，立刻就准备发个朋友圈。
突然。
一阵超越人类所能承受的痛楚袭来。
他“哇”地吐出一口血，不明所以，下意识的低头望去。
——这身体的胸口上，插着一柄剑。
没听说有人穿越的时候胸口插一把剑啊。
别人都是睁开眼，从地上爬起来，严肃地点点头，说一句“原来我穿越了”。
被剑钉住——
这要怎么复活？
许源也不发朋友圈了，艰难地伸出手，用力去拔那柄剑。
剑纹丝不动。
竟然插的这么紧！
……是有什么讲究吗？
许源强忍着剧烈的痛楚，环顾四周，立刻就发现了真相——
这是一座三塔两跨式钢混结合梁的悬索桥，横跨在大江上，长约一万多米。
在桥塔的最高点，发光景观灯构成了四个大字：
“山河大桥。”
而许源就被一柄剑钉在四个大字旁边。
长剑死死插入钢铁结构的桥体，令他高悬在江河之上。
搞清楚情况后，许源不禁倒吸了一口凉气。
——悬挂在这么高的位置，吹着江风，既可以饱览江河夜景，又与“山河大桥”四个字交相辉映。
谁这么有品位？
杀一个普通学生，竟会选如此风骚的位置！
但这对自己来说就有些尴尬。

The bright moon hangs high over the sea of stars, and the sky, earth, and rivers are all white.
All things compete for vitality.
When Xu Yuan opened his eyes, he saw such a beautiful scenery.
"Great scene! Just what I want!"
He praised, feeling excited and longing in his heart.
A few hours ago——
He just climbed to the top of the global eSports league, becoming the annual champion and MVP of multiple eSports games.
I was originally going to celebrate with my friends.
Unexpectedly, the plane crashed into the sea and crashed.
He didn't survive, but survived in another world.
——The current owner of this body is also named Xu Yuan, and he is an ordinary high school senior.
He traveled to this world and replaced the other person in this student.
Once it comes, make peace with it.
Under this beautiful night——
Xu Yuan vowed to live a good life and enjoy the freshness and beauty of youth.
So.
first step.
Selfie hair tie!
Xu Yuan took out his phone, adjusted the angle, clicked a picture, and was immediately ready to post to Moments.
Sudden.
A burst of pain beyond what humans can bear hit.
He spat out a mouthful of blood, not knowing why, and looked down subconsciously.
——There is a sword stuck in the chest of this body.
I have never heard of anyone having a sword stuck in their chest when traveling through time.
Others opened their eyes, got up from the ground, nodded solemnly, and said, "So I have traveled through time."
Nailed by a sword——
How to revive this?
Xu Yuan stopped posting on Moments and stretched out his hand with difficulty to pull out the sword.
The sword didn't move at all.
It's so tight!
...is there anything particular about it?
Xu Yuan endured the severe pain, looked around, and immediately discovered the truth——
This is a three-tower, two-span steel-concrete composite beam suspension bridge that spans the river and is about 10,000 meters long.
At the highest point of the bridge tower, luminous landscape lights form four characters:
"Bridge over Mountains and Rivers."
And Xu Yuan was nailed with a sword next to the four big characters.
The long sword was firmly inserted into the steel structure of the bridge, making him hang high above the river.
After figuring out the situation, Xu Yuan couldn't help but take a breath of cold air.
——Hung at such a high position, with the river breeze blowing, you can not only enjoy the night view of the river, but also complement the four words "Mountain and River Bridge".
Who is so classy?
To kill an ordinary student, he would choose such a coquettish position!
But this is a bit embarrassing for me.
